g.text: Separate charging drawing shows dock and roof solar. Charge currently bypasses INA228: use BMS for total pack coulomb count.

g.desc: Separate charging drawing shows dock and roof solar. Charge currently bypasses INA228: use BMS for total pack coulomb count.

g.text: No component footprints or physical connector pin assignments are specified. This is an architecture review draft.

g.desc: No component footprints or physical connector pin assignments are specified. This is an architecture review draft.

g.text: Every converter block includes a branch fuse. Ratings, protection parts, connectors and physical pinouts remain TBD.

g.desc: Every converter block includes a branch fuse. Ratings, protection parts, connectors and physical pinouts remain TBD.

g.text: K1 is a normally-open DC-rated power disconnect controlled by a hardware stop/reset circuit, not a GPIO relay sketch.

g.desc: K1 is a normally-open DC-rated power disconnect controlled by a hardware stop/reset circuit, not a GPIO relay sketch.

g.text: 6S3P retained. P42A nominal specification: 21.6 V / 12.6 Ah typical; 25.2 V full. 266 Wh is the planning budget.

g.desc: 6S3P retained. P42A nominal specification: 21.6 V / 12.6 Ah typical; 25.2 V full. 266 Wh is the planning budget.

g.text: T12 is rated 14.8 V, charging input 20 V. Neither its battery terminals nor dock accept direct 25.2 V.

g.desc: T12 is rated 14.8 V, charging input 20 V. Neither its battery terminals nor dock accept direct 25.2 V.

g.text: Kinect supply is provisional: identify version, adapter voltage, polarity and current before wiring.

g.desc: Kinect supply is provisional: identify version, adapter voltage, polarity and current before wiring.

g.text: BMS charge/discharge port topology must be followed. GND means protected system return, never bypass BMS at cell B-.

g.desc: BMS charge/discharge port topology must be followed. GND means protected system return, never bypass BMS at cell B-.
